Class ShopController

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.controller.ShopController
@Controller public class ShopController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling all shop-related HTTP requests.

Manages the in-game shop, including card pack opening (free and paid), individual card purchases from the Flash Acquisitions shop, and coin bundle purchases with real-money simulation.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

  • Method Details

    • showPacks

      @GetMapping("/pack") public String showPacks(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Handles GET requests to /pack and displays the pack opening screen.

      Checks if the player is authenticated and determines the pack price: free (0 coins) if the player has a free pack available, or 500 coins otherwise.

      Parameters:
      session - the HttpSession used to retrieve the logged player's information
      model - the Model used to pass pack availability and price to the view
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("pack"), or a redirect to /login if the player is not authenticated

    • getPackAvailablety

      @GetMapping("/pack/price") @ResponseBody public Map<String,Object> getPackAvailablety(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      REST endpoint that returns the current pack price for the logged player.

      Returns 0 if the player has a free pack available, or 500 otherwise.

      Parameters:
      session - the HttpSession used to retrieve the logged player's information
      Returns:
      a Map containing the pack price under the key "price"

    • openPack

      @PostMapping("/pack") public String openPack(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes)
      Handles POST requests to /pack and processes pack opening.

      Generates 5 random cards with rarity-based probabilities. If the pack is free, marks the free pack as used. If paid, deducts 500 coins from the player's balance. Each generated card is added to the player's collection.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass the generated cards to the view
      session - the HttpSession used to retrieve and update the logged player
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass error flash messages
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("pack") with opened cards, a redirect to /pack if insufficient coins, or /login if unauthenticated

    • showShop

      @GetMapping("/shop") public String showShop(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles GET requests to /shop and displays the shop page.

      Retrieves the shop cards available for the logged player, their purchase statuses, the current server time (for countdown timers), and free pack availability. Unauthenticated users see default random cards.

      Parameters:
      model - the Model used to pass shop data to the view
      session - the HttpSession used to retrieve the logged player's information
      Returns:
      the name of the view template ("shop")

    • buyCards

      @PostMapping(value="/shopCards", params="action=buy-card") public String buyCards(@RequestParam int cardId, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles POST requests to /shopCards with action buy-card and processes the purchase of an individual card from the shop.

      Verifies the card exists in the player's shop listing, checks that the player has sufficient coins, deducts the purchase price, adds the card to the player's collection, and marks it as purchased in the shop.

      Parameters:
      cardId - the ID of the card to purchase
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass error flash messages
      session - the HttpSession used to retrieve the logged player
      model - the Model used to pass data to the view
      Returns:
      a redirect to /shop, or /login if unauthenticated

    • buyCoins

      @PostMapping(value="/shop", params="action=buy") public String buyCoins(@RequestParam int price, @RequestParam int coins, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles POST requests to /shop with action buy and redirects the player to the coin purchase confirmation page.

      Passes the selected bundle's price and coin amount as redirect attributes.

      Parameters:
      price - the real-money price of the coin bundle
      coins - the amount of in-game coins in the bundle
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes used to pass bundle details
      session - the HttpSession used to verify authentication
      Returns:
      a redirect to /confirmPurchase, or /login if unauthenticated

    • paymentPage

      @GetMapping("/confirmPurchase") public String paymentPage(@RequestParam int price, @RequestParam int coins, org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles GET requests to /confirmPurchase and displays the payment confirmation page.

      Shows the selected bundle's price and coin amount for the player to confirm before completing the purchase.

      Returns:

    • buyCoins

      @PostMapping("/confirmPurchase") public String buyCoins(@RequestParam int coins, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)
      Handles POST requests to /confirmPurchase and completes the coin purchase.

      Adds the purchased coins to the player's balance and updates the session with the new coin count.

      Parameters:
      coins - the amount of in-game coins to add
      session - the HttpSession used to retrieve and update the logged player
      redirectAttributes - the RedirectAttributes (available for future use)
      Returns:
      a redirect to /shop, or /login if unauthenticated
